messages.game.f86d5e7b09efabb8: The golden rice stalks all swayed at once in the wind. ...It's like the sea.
messages.game.003a743eae1145ae: The name tags for the new 「種」seeds are going wild, so no one knows which field to sow them in.
messages.game.04655ed536dc7207: 種 means a seed that will grow. 産 is used for giving birth or producing something.
messages.game.c2f7a940b39ad6f1: ...They say these seeds grow best in this soil.
messages.game.a0831f2697c1ca25: The farmer said this: "If the name tags couldn't be read, a whole year would have gone to waste"
messages.game.85625fe59d9a1bac: The snow falls silently, flake by flake. ...Every sound is swallowed up by the snow.
messages.game.3448409796c8fe29: The 「倉」storehouse markers are running wild, so no one knows which ones hold the food.
messages.game.3d898475dbe3be33: When the snow 「積」piles up, every storehouse looks the same. That's why they need 「標」markers.
messages.game.f6ebe94404b6f55d: ...Found it. The food inside is still nice and cold.
messages.game.f7a22664103a1800: A villager said this: "Even under the snow, as long as you can read the characters, you won't get lost"
messages.game.990023b1772d4c88: 連 means to connect. A 連絡船 (connecting ferry) links the places on either side of the water.
messages.game.c41d27e0a0a46ff3: ...The characters have gone quiet. The ship has departed.
messages.game.b0cf686ab15116aa: The old man of the island said this: "We've been coming and going on this ship since long, long ago"
messages.game.4603a2bf38b3aea3: Walls of snow tower on both sides. ...Far higher than me.
messages.game.22abd6e3857f4d15: The sign for the passable 「径」path is running wild, so everyone is turning back.
messages.game.dbddc9c353b9cc30: A 「径」path is a narrow way. It runs straight to where you can see the 「景」scenery.
messages.game.dcef38a7f96f07d4: The sun 「照」shone down and the snow walls gleamed. ...How beautiful.
messages.game.8b0c43492144b11e: The guide said this: "One big footprint. And behind it, a trail of small ones"
messages.game.6bd91656467f59b8: The streets bend on purpose. ...It's narrow. I wonder if we can get through here.
messages.game.10efe9aea0c88f86: The 「案」signs guiding people through the 「街」streets are running wild, and lost children keep turning up.
messages.game.a2985e2e305efe6d: When you link the 「案」guides from 「各」each place, the roads become one single path.
messages.game.0b1884d1017b0b1c: ...All the lost children have been found.
messages.game.3ecdeeebcbe434f7: The townspeople said this: "A child became frightened and stopped reading books, because the characters were lined up in rows"
messages.game.ee5fa37de31b3e0f: Katan, katan. ...Each time the 「械」machine moves, the shapes take form.
messages.game.d87bfce485a99e70: The characters to be 「刷」printed on the celebration 「旗」banners are running wild, and they nearly got printed with mistakes.
messages.game.fbb77d8983f2fa29: It's good they 「改」checked over everything before printing a single sheet.
messages.game.db1313d20da7c59c: A hundred banners all dried at once.
messages.game.6f6647288e06e983: Easy said beside me, 'That person is scary, aren't they? ...It's not your fault.'
messages.game.3106d3581a3d01cf: Big bones are sticking out of the ground. ...So creatures like this once existed.
messages.game.75aac888c2e6412a: The characters in the 「記」record of whose bones they are are running wild, so no name can be given to them.
messages.game.8f4ba7d62e9ffa81: If you 「察」carefully infer from what 「残」remains, you can tell what once lived there.
messages.game.0c0057fa3b1b7d3e: A creature 「失」lost long, long ago. ...But the characters remained.
messages.game.eb33aab7857b9678: The scholar said this: "If you look at the tracks, you can tell what passed by. They were lined up in a single row"
messages.game.c002d3d2d9fbea64: ...The characters were blocking the road. We only got through after calming every one of them.
messages.game.fca75ed3fc103d38: ...They're gone. Those characters formed a 「隊」column and went off following someone.
messages.game.1fcab047d784eb54: ...They headed off toward Gifu. Let's follow them.
messages.game.8652fa57509d1b30: ...That was scary. My hands are still shaking.
messages.game.43d7f87bfae3e8a7: The sign for the 「季」season when grapes are plucked is running wild, and they nearly picked fruit that hasn't 「成」ripened yet.
messages.game.e1e680931ea227f2: When the 「季」season changes, the taste of 「果」fruit changes too. ...They say to wait ten more days.
messages.game.965489aee6f1eb7a: ...Let's pick them once they've turned properly sweet.
messages.game.585476581fadb3a4: Easy said this: "So everyone really does hate memorizing, huh." "I've got to teach them more."
messages.game.574bfb8c724bef8e: It's cool and refreshing. ...The wind keeps blowing straight through.
messages.game.4173964f35dfc90b: The signs marking the ranch's boundaries are running wild, so the 「群」herd of cattle spread out everywhere.
messages.game.b84287213c24ce97: The path where the 「群」herd passes, and the path to veer to the 「側」side. A ranch long like a 「帯」sash.
messages.game.a4cf0533c329c3da: All the cattle have come back.
messages.game.1e034964a5c6a8e5: Easy said this: "You can stop now if you want. You could just keep doing only fun things."
messages.game.927253c1aa93728a: ...And this is how I answered: "I do it because it's fun."
messages.game.c455c4cc166a6a3b: White flowers are blooming as far as the eye can see. ...They say every one of them is a buckwheat flower.
messages.game.89e7c84c7d68727b: The sign for the 「順」order of preparation is running wild, so the soba can't be made.
messages.game.7f94496473fc057c: 「初」First the flour, then the water. Get the 「順」order wrong and it all falls to crumbs.
messages.game.2368a38d7898a41e: ...Hey. Let's find that person. I can't just look away anymore.
messages.game.a6a85dddb883db4c: There's a sign that says 「熊」bears appear here. ...If they couldn't read it, it would have been dangerous.
messages.game.fa6ca48e0a3dd200: Written in big letters: "「必」You must read this."
messages.game.867d21cd37cdf88e: The person from the fields said this: "They went up over the mountain, taking the characters along. Without even looking back"
messages.game.1cb0588375339f01: 灯 (light) means a light. Since long ago, it has been used for 漁 (fishing) on this river.
messages.game.21f3f015d1eafe65: ...But the line we saw earlier was different.
messages.game.0f64805ab6ff7224: A person on the boat said this: 'There was a line of lights strung together. They weren't flames. They were all kanji (written characters).'
messages.game.4b6f41e9b551449f: Houses of dark wood stand in a long row. ...They say they've been just like this for a hundred years.
messages.game.df164d79d0bbd5b0: The sign that 説 (explains) the old way to 建 (build) is running wild, so no one can repair the house.
messages.game.5037b41a2d1c4f08: How to join the wood together. The characters of the 説 (explain) explanation were the blueprints themselves.
messages.game.e81921e7853ccfbb: ...It's fixed. They say this house will last another hundred years.
messages.game.b03383f26bc17fc5: The carpenter said this: 'If no one could read the kanji (written characters), this craft would have ended right here.'
messages.game.4767cb467705637c: Beyond the green rows of crops, a great mountain. ...That's the tallest mountain in Japan.
messages.game.c48f9b06e462f52e: The diagram of the 管 (pipe) that carries water is running wild, and water won't flow to the tea fields.
messages.game.8a4dc564580cf969: Raise it up from the 低 (low) places and run it between the rows.
messages.game.85e731ec1550c750: The water is flowing. ...The 香 (fragrance) of the leaves suddenly grew so much stronger.
messages.game.cfe20c71b4d9893b: A person at the tea field said this: 'If the water stops, everything is ruined within a year.'
messages.game.f61747eb824f86f0: The fragrance of steamed leaves fills the whole room.
messages.game.2afe403400658fc7: The 印 (mark) on the 包 (wrapping) is running wild, and the tea is about to go off to the wrong town.
messages.game.4a03dd2b41d3c0e9: If you look at the 印 (mark), you know where the tea is going. ...It's fixed.
messages.game.f53ada8e53875d32: Savory smoke. ...My stomach is growling again.
messages.game.48447a5e6c88e3d5: The characters in the reservation (予約) ledger are running wild, and no one knows how much food (料理) to make.
messages.game.57d27aa7b7837759: If you 録 (record) the 量 (amounts), nothing goes to waste. ...I read it all.
messages.game.f637f3e92cdb62cd: ...The smell is so good I feel dizzy.
messages.game.c2de9a0d3897f464: A person at the shop said this: 'After that person left, a long stream of kanji (written characters) trailed after them.'
messages.game.2fe5dafbe4b26b46: A town where, from morning to night, the sounds of making things never stop.
messages.game.94d5b0f3d48340a1: The procedure signs are running wild, and the machines have stopped.
messages.game.12b97f148f329a3c: The old 法 (method) and the new 法 (method). Right where they 変 (changed) to a 別 (different) approach, the characters went wild.
messages.game.49998e1a1aec5e68: ...It's moving! All the sounds came back at once.
messages.game.441067f19444270b: A 働 (working) person said this: 'When the kanji (written characters) stop, the whole town stops.'
messages.game.69835ed6050ccb00: A traveler said this: 'A line of kanji (written characters) went strung together. At the front, one large 傘 (umbrella).'
messages.game.493ea3d04a70810f: ...This is the last town in the Chubu region.
messages.game.6b1de1af71c33c54: The post-station inn where travelers rested still remains today.
messages.game.fa5dafffffcae496: An island floats all alone beyond the sea. …How do we get over there?
messages.game.a17197ae7a397518: The characters on the timetable are rampaging, so the boat can't leave. …Oh.
messages.game.18c5c0e1d885d6c9: Hey. The next boat is at three in the afternoon. I looked it up for you.
messages.game.9eca33470efc1f7f: I'm faster at this kind of thing, after all.
messages.game.ad27492a9762de50: …Thanks. Things really go faster with you around.
messages.game.dc08a414341fb651: …But that character is still rampaging. Let's go.
messages.game.e7717ba72bc2042d: Look. That's the tallest mountain in Japan.
messages.game.f3271ed589bbec23: Bright red apples line the branches. …That round mark is multiplying again.
messages.game.b31ed62ef2b998ce: …Oh. The kids are walking in a line. Up ahead, something yellow—
messages.game.df9f0d91fba0b49e: Hey. Perfect timing. This signboard is rampaging.
messages.game.425192e8b76870da: That character reads 「熊」 (kuma, bear). Go on, give it a try.
messages.game.0b5db140cc7ce0e2: The kids all read it at once. …The character went quiet.
messages.game.5edb3e83ae8ac941: I've learned to teach, just like you, Mana.
messages.game.fe5a12840149343b: And you know what? I can teach a hundred, even two hundred people at once.
messages.game.7d03a29eed7374a9: The kids are laughing. "Me next — I'll read it!"
messages.game.f372cb2120f27143: Night. From the castle, you can look down at the river.
messages.game.8b541001351ff771: …Look. A road leading to Nagoya Castle.
messages.game.0d17bc4e07f293ed: Characters are moving in a line stretching far into the distance.
messages.game.6b55b2e1f42d09e0: …So many of them. There were only a few at first.
